question: Why is the ordinary person established in the divine yet unaware of it?
premises: The ordinary person abides in the midst of all and is established in the divine
He is not grounded in the light of awareness
He treats the divine presence as if it were unreal
inference: Being established in the divine does not guarantee recognition when one lacks grounding in light.
plain_english: Because he abides in the midst of all, he is indeed established in me; yet, because he is not grounded in the light and treats it as unreal, he does not recognize this.
